name: com.uee03.pretzel.vcontainer
description: VContainer scopes for Pretzel: PretzelLifetimeScope, ScriptableInstaller and MonoInstaller, and the setup the Project Setup window generates on top of them. Needs no other Pretzel module. The assembly compiles only when VContainer is installed.

samples.description: Every VContainer feature in one scene with one LifetimeScope, one folder per feature: registration, lifetimes, injection, entry points, tickable timers and bullets, factories, components, collections, keys, open generics, settings, installers, callbacks and child scopes.
